title: DARPA SID program protection would kill insider threats

tellings.quote: There's the DARPA SID uh if you're considered an insider outsider threat to them, they'll just kill you.

plain: A secret part of DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, which he calls SID, will kill people it sees as a threat from inside or outside, according to an online researcher who posts as UAPGerb. He says on the show, "if you're considered an insider outsider threat to them, they'll just kill you," and he had posted about it before; he links the claim to David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who has spoken out about secret UFO work. If true, it would mean the secrecy around these programmes is guarded with lethal force.
